abilities.description: Active abilities that cost resources or have limited uses. Organized by calling. Effect schemas use handler keys (heal, dodge, extraAction, weapon_attack, etc.) for generic dispatch.

dedication.name: Steady Nerve
dedication.description: You have a well of inner resolve to draw upon. As a bonus action, choose one: Heal (regain 1d8 + your level + CON modifier HP) or Dodge (attackers have disadvantage until start of your next turn).

options.name: Heal
options.description: Regain 1d8 + level + CON modifier hit points

options.name: Dodge
options.description: Until the start of your next turn, attack rolls against you have disadvantage

dedication.name: Action Surge
dedication.description: You can push yourself beyond normal limits. On your turn, take one additional action. Once per short rest. Exemplar capstone (level 10) grants a second use per short rest.
